name: Test Package Installation

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'pyproject.vllm.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - 'uv.vllm.lock'
      - 'areal/**'
      - '.github/workflows/install-test.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'pyproject.vllm.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - 'uv.vllm.lock'
      - 'areal/**'
      - '.github/workflows/install-test.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: install-test-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  install-test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        python-version: ['3.12']
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: Install test (${{ matrix.os }}, Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: |
            uv.lock
            uv.vllm.lock

      - name: Set up Python
        run: uv python install ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install package (basic)
        run: uv sync

      - name: Verify package import
        run: |
          uv run python -c "import areal; print(f'areal version: {areal.__version__}')"

      - name: Verify core modules are importable
        run: |
          uv run python -c "
          from areal import (
              TrainController,
              RolloutController,
              WorkflowExecutor,
              StalenessManager,
              workflow_context,
              current_platform,
          )
          print('All core modules imported successfully')
          "

      - name: Build wheel
        run: uv build --wheel

      - name: Verify wheel artifact
        run: |
          ls -la dist/
          python -m zipfile -l dist/*.whl | head -20

  install-test-cuda-extras:
    # Test CUDA extras installation on Linux only (CUDA packages have Linux-only wheels)
    # Note: flash-attn is excluded because it requires CUDA compilation infrastructure

    # sglang and vllm are conflicting extras, so we test each separately

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        variant: [sglang, vllm]
    name: Install test (Linux, CUDA extras, ${{ matrix.variant }})

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: |
            uv.lock
            uv.vllm.lock

      - name: Set up Python
        run: uv python install 3.12

      - name: Install package with CUDA extras (excluding flash-attn)
        # flash-attn requires CUDA toolkit for compilation, skip it in CI
        # Test individual extras that have pre-built wheels
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.variant }}" = "vllm" ]; then

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
